universeDiscovery.notes: BIST master registry symbols filtered to equity-only types: Equity, Bank, Insurance, Holding, REIT

discoveryResults.coverageMeaning: 6 of 1075 registry symbols (0.56%) have real Yahoo Finance price data validated; remaining symbols marked UNAVAILABLE or INVALID due to non-equity type or lack of market data
discoveryResults.source: Yahoo Finance (single provider, no second pipeline)
discoveryResults.notes: Single Yahoo Finance source only; no second market-data pipeline created; no second cache engine created. All non-6 test symbols lack validated market data at runtime.

testSymbolUniverse.coverageMeaning: 100% of test fixture symbols have Yahoo Finance price data (AVAILABLE status, VALID dataQuality)
testSymbolUniverse.notes: 6 test symbols are a FIXTURE/VALIDATION universe, separate from the discovery results above. Verified prices: THYAO=305.25, AKBNK=68.80, ASELS=387.50, BIMAS=374.75, TUPRS=361.75, GARAN=131.00 TRY

productionUniverse.notes: Production BIST equity universe not accessible via machine-readable authoritative API at runtime. 6 test symbols provide validated foundation; remaining ~1069 symbols lack confirmed price data. Universe discovery method available for future when data sources become available.

symbolNormalization.notes: Deterministic normalization applied; providerSymbol → internalSymbol mapping is source-aware. Equity types only; non-equity symbols excluded from discovery.

instrumentTypes.assigned: see per-symbol assetType in discovery results
instrumentTypes.notes: Instrument types from BIST master registry: Equity (535), Bank (21), Insurance (10), Holding (8), REIT (7). Non-equity types (Fund, Derivative, Index, etc.) excluded from equity filtering.

marketSegments.notes: BIST market segments not researched from official Borsa İstanbul source at runtime; null when unknown. Future work: integrate KAP/MKK segment data when available under single-pipeline constraint.

sectorMetadata.notes: Sector metadata not researched from official KAP source at runtime; empty when unknown. Future work: integrate KAP sector metadata when available under single-pipeline constraint.

daily.notes: Yahoo Finance real historical OHLCV for 6 test symbols via 1D timeframe. All other discovery symbols lack daily OHLCV.

fourHour.notes: Provider does not natively support 4H BIST historical data; derived candles prohibited. Single pipeline constraint.

weekly.notes: Provider does not natively support 1W BIST historical data; weekly aggregation from daily marked as DERIVED. Single pipeline constraint.

monthly.notes: Provider does not natively support 1M BIST historical data; monthly aggregation from daily marked as DERIVED. Single pipeline constraint.

sma9.notes: SMA9 calculated from daily close prices; null when <9 data points. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

sma20.notes: SMA20 calculated from daily close prices; null when <20 data points. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

sma50.notes: SMA50 calculated from daily close prices; null when <50 data points. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

rsi.notes: RSI14 calculated from daily close prices; deterministic, documented, tested. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

macd.notes: MACD computed from daily close prices; convention documented. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

averageVolume20.notes: 20-day average volume from historical data; null when insufficient sample. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

averageVolume50.notes: 50-day average volume from historical data; null when insufficient sample. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

relativeVolume.notes: Current volume / 20-day average volume; null when averageVolume = 0. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

1D.notes: 1-day return from close prices; timestamp-aware, no look-ahead bias. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

20D.notes: 20-day return from close prices; no future data usage. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

60D.notes: 60-day return from close prices; no future data usage. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

252D.notes: 252-day (~1 year) return from close prices; no future data usage. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

lookAheadProtection.notes: Historical features use only T and prior data; T+1 information does not flow into T features. Enabled from R2-063.

cache.hitMiss: Cache hit/miss tracked per provider budget (R2-050C)
cache.notes: Existing cache system used; no new cache engine created. Single pipeline constraint maintained.

providerBudget.controlledRequests: No uncontrolled parallel requests across BIST universe
providerBudget.notes: Existing R2-050C system active; no new pipeline created. Single source (Yahoo Finance) only.

dataQualityMetadata.coverage: 6/6 test symbols, 0.56% of registry symbols validated

invalidDataHandling.ohlcValidation: high >= max(open,close), low <= min(open,close); anomalies → INVALID
invalidDataHandling.duplicateCandles: Deterministic deduplication by source priority; random selection prohibited
invalidDataHandling.missingCandles: NO_DATA_EXPECTED state; price=0 not used as filler

opportunityEngine.currentStatus: NOT modified in R2-064; foundation only
opportunityEngine.note: Data provenance preserved from R2-063; verified foundation established for future opportunity scoring (R2-065+)
opportunityEngine.note2: Synthetic never labeled official; single pipeline constraint maintained

backtestCompatibility.notes: All historical features include timestamp; designed for future backtest integration
backtestCompatibility.lookAheadBias: Prevented at feature-calculation level. Enabled from R2-063.
